player_prompt.intro:
O wewe Mwana {player_id} na mbanza ya {num_rounds}-mbanza ya Rock-Paper-Scissors.
Kimpwanza kiaku ni kuwina mbanza mingi ikele.
Na kila mbanza, yembela na mo: '[rock]', '[paper]', to '[scissors]'.
O wewe pia koyemba '[r]', '[p]', to '[s]' na njia ya kufupisha.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kibandi kiaku kitambulwa te. Yemba [rock], [paper], to [scissors].

message.round_draw: Nsuka ya nsaka: Bo me sala diama.
message.round_win: Nsuka ya nsaka: Muntu yina ke sala {winner} me nunga!
